files.reason: clustering_hold rule: a not_received refund under the manager line is held for a manager once the merchant's running not_received total inside refunds.clustering_window_days reaches refunds.manager_approval_usd_minor (rejected refunds excluded, window 0 = off); plus the held-cluster lookup the KYC rule reads by customer email

register clustering_hold last on execute, declare refunds.clustering_window_days (default 14, 0 = off), add its rule label and fields, and export the held-cluster lookup and the manager default for KYC
linked_refund_hold on approve, before escalated_needs_manager: a case whose email matches a customer in a held refund cluster needs a KYC manager whatever the risk score

refund acceptance tests for clustering_hold: first refund applies, crossing and later refunds held at manager tier with merchant and running total, other reasons, rejected, out-of-window and over-the-line refunds unaffected, window 0 switch, rule order, declared constant, manager approval

'every row in the group is allowed on its own by amount_approval' asserts each Kestrel row's execute preview effect is allow; with clustering_hold only the oldest row (rfnd_0014) is allowed and the other three are held, so the effect assertion moves while the amount_approval allow assertion stays
'approve's rules run in order with the new rules before escalation' asserts the exact approve rule list; linked_refund_hold is inserted between declared_vs_found and escalated_needs_manager
linked_refund_hold cases: a case whose customer is in a held cluster goes to a manager whatever the score, a score-68 case with no held refunds still clears, and window 0 stops the linked hold
contingency: asserts execute decisions on seeded refunds (rfnd_0001 not_received applies straight through); modified only if the clustering_hold trace entry moves one of these assertions
contingency: executes Kestrel refunds and counts held refunds per case; modified only if clustering_hold changes a held count it asserts
contingency: submits 60 Fernhill Home not_received refunds through execute, most of which clustering_hold now sends to pending_approval; modified only if an applied/pending/audit assertion moves
